title: List all risk events with details
description: Returns all events with timestamp, actor, risk type, risk score, and impacted assets.

title: High-risk events (score > 0.7)
description: Returns events where the associated risk has a score above 0.7, ordered by score descending.

title: Events in a date range (1-7 Jul 2026)
description: Returns events within a specific date range using the optimised eventDate index.

title: Events by a specific actor (APT-28)
description: Returns all events attributed to a named threat actor.

title: Count events per actor
description: Returns the number of risk events attributed to each actor, ordered by count descending.

title: Count events per risk type
description: Returns how many events are associated with each risk classification.

title: Most impacted assets
description: Returns assets ranked by the number of risk events that impact them.

title: Assets impacted by a specific risk (Ransomware)
description: Returns all assets impacted by events involving a named risk type.

title: Actor-to-asset exposure matrix
description: Shows which actors have impacted which assets, with the highest risk score for each pair.

title: Full event timeline
description: Returns a chronological timeline of all risk events with actor and risk details.

title: List all incident response processes
description: Returns all mitigation processes with their status, owner, and the event they mitigate.

title: Process steps with completion status
description: Returns all steps for all processes with their step number, owner, and completion status.

title: Incomplete process steps requiring action
description: Returns all process steps that are not yet complete, grouped by owner.

title: Severe events with no mitigation process
description: Returns high-risk events (score > 0.7) that have no incident response process assigned.

title: Process status summary
description: Returns a count of processes grouped by status.
